summary: Vetted the union of task 299 (modal K tableau, 11 files under Cslib/Logics/Modal/Tableau/) and task 455 (shared tableau measure module: 2 new Foundations files, 2 shared touch-points CompletenessLoop.lean/FmpMeasure.lean, 2 repointed consumers) against CONTRIBUTING.md, NOTATION.md, ORGANISATION.md, and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md. Seven suggested fix tasks are recorded in .vet-findings.json, none blocking merge.
